ko.title: 국경 너머의 더 높은 가격: 미국-캐나다 관세 대치가 자동차, 목재, 식료품에 미치는 의미

segments.src: When trade talks between Washington and Ottawa stall and tariffs stay in place, the effects rarely stay in the negotiating room.
segments.tr: 워싱턴과 오타와 간의 무역 협상이 교착 상태에 빠지고 관세가 유지되면, 그 영향은 협상실 안에만 머무르지 않습니다.

segments.src: They travel through factories, lumberyards, trucking routes and grocery distribution centers before they show up as a number on a receipt or a sticker price.
segments.tr: 그 영향은 공장, 제재소, 트럭 운송 경로 및 식료품 유통 센터를 거쳐 영수증의 숫자나 정가표에 나타나게 됩니다.

segments.src: This explainer walks through how a cross-border dispute can reach everyday purchases, and which signals are worth watching as the review of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) continues.
segments.tr: 이 설명 자료는 국경 간 분쟁이 어떻게 일상적인 구매에까지 영향을 미칠 수 있는지, 그리고 미국-멕시코-캐나다 협정(USMCA) 검토가 계속됨에 따라 어떤 신호를 주목해야 하는지 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 합니다.

segments.src: It is not financial, investment or legal advice, and conditions in trade policy change quickly.
segments.tr: 이는 금융, 투자 또는 법률 자문이 아니며, 무역 정책의 상황은 빠르게 변합니다.

segments.src: Check official sources for the latest figures.*
segments.tr: 최신 수치는 공식 출처를 확인하십시오.*

segments.src: ## Why this trade relationship is different
segments.tr: ## 이 무역 관계가 특별한 이유

segments.src: The United States and Canada trade goods and services on a scale few country pairs match.
segments.tr: 미국과 캐나다는 다른 국가들이 거의 따라올 수 없는 규모로 상품과 서비스를 교역합니다.

segments.src: Much of that trade is not finished products crossing the border once.
segments.tr: 그 교역의 상당 부분은 완제품이 국경을 한 번 건너는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is parts, materials and ingredients that move back and forth several times before reaching a customer.
segments.tr: 부품, 원자재, 재료가 고객에게 도달하기 전에 여러 번 국경을 왔다 갔다 합니다.

segments.src: That integration is the reason a tariff on one side of the line can raise costs on both.
segments.tr: 이러한 통합이 바로 국경 한쪽의 관세가 양쪽 모두의 비용을 상승시킬 수 있는 이유입니다.

segments.src: A duty is generally paid by the importing company.
segments.tr: 관세는 일반적으로 수입 업체가 지불합니다.

segments.src: What happens next depends on the business: it can absorb the cost, negotiate with suppliers, change where it sources goods, or pass some or all of the increase on to customers.
segments.tr: 그다음 무슨 일이 일어날지는 기업에 달려 있습니다. 비용을 흡수하거나, 공급업체와 협상하거나, 상품 조달처를 변경하거나, 인상분의 일부 또는 전부를 고객에게 전가할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Economists often describe this as "pass-through," and it varies widely by product, season and market competition.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 이를 종종 "전가(pass-through)"라고 표현하며, 이는 제품, 계절, 시장 경쟁 상황에 따라 크게 달라집니다.

segments.src: ## Cars: a border that parts cross many times
segments.tr: ## 자동차: 부품이 여러 번 국경을 넘는 산업

segments.src: Auto manufacturing is the clearest example of an integrated supply chain.
segments.tr: 자동차 제조는 통합 공급망의 가장 명확한 예입니다.

segments.src: An engine component, a transmission or a wiring harness may cross the U.S.-Canada border more than once during assembly.
segments.tr: 엔진 부품, 변속기 또는 와이어링 하니스는 조립 과정 중에 미국-캐나다 국경을 여러 번 넘을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If duties apply at each crossing, or to certain materials such as steel and aluminum, the cost can compound.
segments.tr: 각 통관 시 관세가 부과되거나 철강 및 알루미늄과 같은 특정 재료에 관세가 부과되면 비용이 복합적으로 증가할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: What this can mean for shoppers:
segments.tr: 이것이 쇼핑객에게 의미하는 바:

segments.src: - **New vehicle prices.** Higher production costs can contribute to higher sticker prices or fewer discounts, though automakers weigh this against competition and demand.
segments.tr: - **신차 가격.** 생산 비용 상승은 정가 인상이나 할인 축소로 이어질 수 있지만, 자동차 제조사는 이를 경쟁 및 수요와 비교하여 결정합니다.

segments.src: - **Repair and replacement parts.** Parts that cross the border can become more expensive, which may affect repair bills and insurance costs over time.
segments.tr: - **수리 및 교체 부품.** 국경을 넘는 부품이 더 비싸질 수 있으며, 이는 시간이 지남에 따라 수리비와 보험료에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Production decisions.** Manufacturers may shift output between plants, which can affect model availability and delivery times.
segments.tr: - **생산 결정.** 제조사는 공장 간 생산량을 조정할 수 있으며, 이는 모델 가용성과 배송 시간에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Lumber: housing costs and a long-running dispute
segments.tr: ## 목재: 주택 비용과 오랜 분쟁

segments.src: Softwood lumber has been a point of friction between the two countries for decades.
segments.tr: 침엽수 목재는 수십 년 동안 양국 간 마찰의 원인이었습니다.

segments.src: Canada supplies a significant share of the softwood used in American construction, and additional duties on top of existing ones can raise the cost of framing materials.
segments.tr: 캐나다는 미국 건설에 사용되는 침엽수의 상당 부분을 공급하며, 기존 관세에 추가 관세가 부과되면 골조 자재 비용이 상승할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Lumber matters beyond the lumberyard because it feeds into:
segments.tr: 목재는 제재소를 넘어 다음 분야에도 영향을 미치기 때문에 중요합니다:

segments.src: - the cost of building new homes,
segments.tr: - 신규 주택 건설 비용,

segments.src: - remodeling and repair projects,
segments.tr: - 리모델링 및 수리 프로젝트,

segments.src: - and, indirectly, housing affordability in a market where supply is already tight.
segments.tr: - 그리고 간접적으로는 공급이 이미 부족한 시장에서의 주택 구입 능력.

segments.src: Builders may respond by seeking other suppliers, changing project timing or adjusting prices.
segments.tr: 건설업체는 다른 공급업체를 찾거나, 프로젝트 일정을 변경하거나, 가격을 조정하는 방식으로 대응할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Any effect on a particular home depends on many other factors, including interest rates, labor costs and local demand.
segments.tr: 특정 주택에 미치는 영향은 금리, 인건비, 지역 수요 등 다른 많은 요인에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: ## Groceries: the slow, uneven path to the checkout
segments.tr: ## 식료품: 계산대까지의 느리고 불균등한 경로

segments.src: Food prices respond to trade policy less directly, but the links are real.
segments.tr: 식품 가격은 무역 정책에 덜 직접적으로 반응하지만, 그 연관성은 분명합니다.

segments.src: Canada and the United States exchange large volumes of agricultural and processed goods, from produce and grains to meat, dairy and packaged foods.
segments.tr: 캐나다와 미국은 농산물과 가공식품부터 농산물, 곡물, 육류, 유제품, 포장 식품에 이르기까지 방대한 양의 상품을 교역합니다.

segments.src: Packaging, fertilizer, fuel and transportation costs can also be affected by tariffs on materials and equipment.
segments.tr: 포장재, 비료, 연료 및 운송 비용도 재료와 장비에 대한 관세의 영향을 받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Several things make grocery effects harder to predict:
segments.tr: 식료품에 미치는 영향을 예측하기 어렵게 만드는 몇 가지 요인이 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Seasonality.** Fresh produce often comes from different regions at different times of year, so sourcing can shift.
segments.tr: - **계절성.** 신선 농산물은 종종 연중 시기에 따라 다른 지역에서 오기 때문에 조달처가 바뀔 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Retail competition.** Grocers may absorb part of a cost increase to keep customers, or spread it across many items so no single price jumps sharply.
segments.tr: - **소매 경쟁.** 식료품점은 고객을 유지하기 위해 비용 인상분의 일부를 흡수하거나, 특정 품목의 가격이 급격히 오르지 않도록 여러 품목에 분산시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Retaliation.** If one country responds to duties with its own, goods that cross the border in the other direction can be affected too.
segments.tr: - **보복.** 한 국가가 관세로 대응하면, 반대 방향으로 국경을 넘는 상품도 영향을 받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Consumers may notice changes first in specific categories rather than across the whole basket.
segments.tr: 소비자는 전체 장바구니 물가보다는 특정 품목에서 변화를 먼저 느낄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch in the USMCA review
segments.tr: ## USMCA 검토에서 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: The USMCA includes a scheduled joint review process, which gives all three member countries a formal moment to decide whether to extend the agreement or to keep reviewing it.
segments.tr: USMCA에는 정기적인 공동 검토 절차가 포함되어 있으며, 이는 3개 회원국 모두가 협정을 연장할지 아니면 계속 검토할지 결정할 공식적인 기회를 제공합니다.

segments.src: Beyond the headlines, several developments are worth following:
segments.tr: 헤드라인 너머로, 몇 가지 주목할 만한 발전 사항이 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Whether talks resume and on what terms.** Formal negotiating sessions, rather than public statements alone, are the clearer sign of progress.
segments.tr: 1. **협상 재개 여부와 조건.** 공개 성명보다는 공식적인 협상 세션이 진전의 더 명확한 신호입니다.

segments.src: 2. **Rules of origin.** These rules decide which products qualify for preferential treatment. Changes, especially for autos, could shift costs significantly.
segments.tr: 2. **원산지 규정.** 이 규정은 어떤 제품이 특혜 대우를 받을 자격이 있는지 결정합니다. 특히 자동차에 대한 변경 사항은 비용을 크게 변화시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Exemptions and carve-outs.** Sector-specific relief can matter as much as a headline tariff rate.
segments.tr: 3. **면제 및 예외 조항.** 부문별 구제 조치는 헤드라인 관세율만큼 중요할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Dispute settlement.** How disagreements are handled can shape how predictable trade is for businesses.
segments.tr: 4. **분쟁 해결.** 의견 불일치를 처리하는 방식은 기업에게 무역의 예측 가능성을 결정짓는 요소가 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 5. **Official price data.** Consumer price reports and producer price indexes show whether costs are moving through the economy, and how quickly.
segments.tr: 5. **공식 물가 데이터.** 소비자 물가 보고서와 생산자 물가 지수는 비용이 경제 전반으로 전이되고 있는지, 그리고 얼마나 빠르게 전이되는지를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: ## What readers can do
segments.tr: ## 독자가 할 수 있는 일

segments.src: There is no need to react to every headline.
segments.tr: 모든 헤드라인에 일일이 반응할 필요는 없습니다.

segments.src: A few practical habits can help:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 실용적인 습관이 도움이 될 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - Compare prices across retailers for big purchases such as vehicles or building materials.
segments.tr: - 자동차나 건축 자재와 같은 큰 구매를 할 때는 소매점별로 가격을 비교하십시오.

segments.src: - For home projects, ask contractors how material costs are built into quotes and how long those quotes are valid.
segments.tr: - 주택 프로젝트의 경우, 계약자에게 자재 비용이 견적에 어떻게 포함되어 있는지, 그리고 해당 견적이 얼마나 유효한지 문의하십시오.

segments.src: - Track your own grocery spending by category to see whether changes are broad or limited to certain items.
segments.tr: - 식료품 지출을 카테고리별로 추적하여 변화가 광범위한지 아니면 특정 품목에 국한된 것인지 확인하십시오.

segments.src: - Rely on official statistics and established news outlets for trade updates rather than single social media posts.
segments.tr: - 무역 관련 업데이트는 단일 소셜 미디어 게시물보다는 공식 통계와 신뢰할 수 있는 뉴스 매체를 참고하십시오.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Tariff disputes between close trading partners tend to work like a slow tide rather than a single wave.
segments.tr: 긴밀한 무역 파트너 간의 관세 분쟁은 단일 파도보다는 느린 밀물처럼 작용하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Costs can build in supply chains for months before reaching consumers, and some are absorbed along the way.
segments.tr: 비용은 소비자에게 도달하기까지 수개월 동안 공급망에 쌓일 수 있으며, 일부는 그 과정에서 흡수되기도 합니다.

segments.src: For cars, lumber and groceries alike, the outcome depends on how long duties last, which goods are exempted, and what negotiators agree to in the USMCA review.
segments.tr: 자동차, 목재, 식료품 모두 관세가 얼마나 지속되는지, 어떤 상품이 면제되는지, 그리고 협상가들이 USMCA 검토에서 무엇에 합의하는지에 따라 결과가 달라집니다.

segments.src: Following those milestones, and the official price data that follows them, is the most reliable way to understand what the standoff may mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: 그러한 이정표와 그에 따른 공식 물가 데이터를 따르는 것이 이 대치가 가계 예산에 어떤 의미를 가질지 이해하는 가장 확실한 방법입니다.

segments.tr: 这对购车者可能意味着：

segments.src: - **New vehicle prices.** Higher production costs can contribute to higher sticker prices or fewer discounts, though automakers weigh this against competition and demand.
segments.tr: - **新车价格。** 生产成本上升可能会推高标价或减少折扣，不过汽车制造商会将其与市场竞争和需求进行权衡。

segments.src: - **Repair and replacement parts.** Parts that cross the border can become more expensive, which may affect repair bills and insurance costs over time.
segments.tr: - **维修和更换零部件。** 跨境零部件可能会变得更加昂贵，随着时间的推移，这可能会影响维修账单和保险成本。

segments.src: - **Production decisions.** Manufacturers may shift output between plants, which can affect model availability and delivery times.
segments.tr: - **生产决策。** 制造商可能会在不同工厂之间调整产量分配，这可能会影响车型供应量和交付时间。

segments.src: ## Lumber: housing costs and a long-running dispute
segments.tr: ## 木材：住房成本与一场长期的争端

segments.src: Softwood lumber has been a point of friction between the two countries for decades.
segments.tr: 数十年来，软木一直是两国摩擦的焦点。

segments.src: Canada supplies a significant share of the softwood used in American construction, and additional duties on top of existing ones can raise the cost of framing materials.
segments.tr: 加拿大供应了美国建筑中使用的软木的大部分份额，在现有关税之上加征额外关税会推高框架材料的成本。

segments.src: Lumber matters beyond the lumberyard because it feeds into:
segments.tr: 木材的影响超出了木材厂本身，因为它直接影响到：

segments.src: - the cost of building new homes,
segments.tr: - 建造新房的成本，

segments.src: - remodeling and repair projects,
segments.tr: - 翻新与维修项目，

segments.src: - and, indirectly, housing affordability in a market where supply is already tight.
segments.tr: - 以及间接影响到在供应本已紧张的市场中的住房负担能力。

segments.src: Builders may respond by seeking other suppliers, changing project timing or adjusting prices.
segments.tr: 建筑商可能会通过寻找其他供应商、改变项目进度或调整价格来应对。

segments.src: Any effect on a particular home depends on many other factors, including interest rates, labor costs and local demand.
segments.tr: 对特定房屋产生的具体影响取决于许多其他因素，包括利率、人工成本和当地需求。

segments.src: ## Groceries: the slow, uneven path to the checkout
segments.tr: ## 杂货：通往结账台的缓慢而非均衡之路

segments.src: Food prices respond to trade policy less directly, but the links are real.
segments.tr: 食品价格对贸易政策的反应不够直接，但这种关联是真实存在的。

segments.src: Canada and the United States exchange large volumes of agricultural and processed goods, from produce and grains to meat, dairy and packaged foods.
segments.tr: 加拿大和美国交换大量的农产品和加工食品，从新鲜农作物、粮食到肉类、乳制品和包装食品。

segments.src: Packaging, fertilizer, fuel and transportation costs can also be affected by tariffs on materials and equipment.
segments.tr: 包装、化肥、燃料和运输成本也可能受到材料和设备关税的影响。

segments.src: Several things make grocery effects harder to predict:
segments.tr: 有几点因素使得杂货价格受到的影响难以预测：

segments.src: - **Seasonality.** Fresh produce often comes from different regions at different times of year, so sourcing can shift.
segments.tr: - **季节性。** 新鲜农产品在一年中的不同时间往往来自不同地区，因此采购渠道可能会发生转移。

segments.src: - **Retail competition.** Grocers may absorb part of a cost increase to keep customers, or spread it across many items so no single price jumps sharply.
segments.tr: - **零售竞争。** 杂货商可能会消化一部分增加的成本以留住顾客，或者将其分摊到多种商品上，使单一商品价格不至于大幅跳升。

segments.src: - **Retaliation.** If one country responds to duties with its own, goods that cross the border in the other direction can be affected too.
segments.tr: - **报复措施。** 如果一国对另一国的关税作出报复性关税回应，向相反方向跨境的商品也会受到影响。

segments.src: Consumers may notice changes first in specific categories rather than across the whole basket.
segments.tr: 消费者可能会首先在特定品类而非整个购物篮中察觉到变化。

segments.src: ## What to watch in the USMCA review
segments.tr: ## 在 USMCA 审查中应关注什么

segments.src: The USMCA includes a scheduled joint review process, which gives all three member countries a formal moment to decide whether to extend the agreement or to keep reviewing it.
segments.tr: USMCA 包含一项预定的联合审查机制，该机制赋予所有三个成员国一个正式的时机，以决定是延长协议还是继续对其进行审查。

segments.src: Beyond the headlines, several developments are worth following:
segments.tr: 除了头条新闻之外，有几项进展值得关注：

segments.src: 1. **Whether talks resume and on what terms.** Formal negotiating sessions, rather than public statements alone, are the clearer sign of progress.
segments.tr: 1. **谈判是否恢复及其条件。** 正式的谈判会议，而非仅仅是公开声明，才是取得进展的更明确信号。

segments.src: 2. **Rules of origin.** These rules decide which products qualify for preferential treatment. Changes, especially for autos, could shift costs significantly.
segments.tr: 2. **原产地规则。** 这些规则决定了哪些产品有资格享受优惠待遇。规则的变化（尤其是针对汽车）可能会显著改变成本结构。

segments.src: 3. **Exemptions and carve-outs.** Sector-specific relief can matter as much as a headline tariff rate.
segments.tr: 3. **豁免与例外条款。** 针对特定行业的减免措施与头条关税税率同等重要。

segments.src: 4. **Dispute settlement.** How disagreements are handled can shape how predictable trade is for businesses.
segments.tr: 4. **争端解决。** 分歧的处理方式可以塑造企业贸易环境的可预测性。

segments.src: 5. **Official price data.** Consumer price reports and producer price indexes show whether costs are moving through the economy, and how quickly.
segments.tr: 5. **官方价格数据。** 消费者价格报告和生产者价格指数展示了成本是否正在整个经济中传导以及传导的速度。

segments.src: ## What readers can do
segments.tr: ## 读者可以做什么

segments.src: There is no need to react to every headline.
segments.tr: 没有必要对每一个头条新闻都作出过度反应。

segments.src: A few practical habits can help:
segments.tr: 养成一些实用的习惯会有所帮助：

segments.src: - Compare prices across retailers for big purchases such as vehicles or building materials.
segments.tr: - 在购买汽车或建筑材料等大件商品时，横向比较不同零售商的价格。

segments.src: - For home projects, ask contractors how material costs are built into quotes and how long those quotes are valid.
segments.tr: - 对于房屋建造或翻新项目，询问承包商材料成本是如何计入报价的，以及这些报价的有效期有多长。

segments.src: - Track your own grocery spending by category to see whether changes are broad or limited to certain items.
segments.tr: - 按品类追踪你自己的杂货支出，以观察价格变化是广泛的还是仅限于特定商品。

segments.src: - Rely on official statistics and established news outlets for trade updates rather than single social media posts.
segments.tr: - 依靠官方统计数据和建立已久的主流新闻媒体来获取最新的贸易动态，而不是依赖单条社交媒体动态。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Tariff disputes between close trading partners tend to work like a slow tide rather than a single wave.
segments.tr: 紧密贸易伙伴之间的关税争端通常像缓慢涨落的潮汐，而非单一的巨浪。

segments.src: Costs can build in supply chains for months before reaching consumers, and some are absorbed along the way.
segments.tr: 成本可能在供应链中积聚数月才传导至消费者，而且部分成本会在传导途中被消化掉。

segments.src: For cars, lumber and groceries alike, the outcome depends on how long duties last, which goods are exempted, and what negotiators agree to in the USMCA review.
segments.tr: 无论是汽车、木材还是杂货，最终结果都取决于关税持续多久、哪些商品获得豁免，以及谈判人员在 USMCA 审查中达成何种协议。

segments.src: Following those milestones, and the official price data that follows them, is the most reliable way to understand what the standoff may mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: 关注这些里程碑事件以及随之公布的官方价格数据，是了解这场对峙对家庭预算意味着什么的最可靠途径。

hi.title: सीमा के उत्तर में, उच्च कीमतें: यू.एस.-कनाडा टैरिफ गतिरोध का कारों, लकड़ी और किराने के सामान के लिए क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: When trade talks between Washington and Ottawa stall and tariffs stay in place, the effects rarely stay in the negotiating room.
segments.tr: जब वाशिंगटन और ओटावा के बीच व्यापार वार्ता रुक जाती है और टैरिफ लागू रहते हैं, तो इसके प्रभाव शायद ही कभी बातचीत के कमरे तक सीमित रहते हैं।

segments.src: They travel through factories, lumberyards, trucking routes and grocery distribution centers before they show up as a number on a receipt or a sticker price.
segments.tr: वे रसीद पर किसी संख्या या स्टिकर मूल्य के रूप में दिखाई देने से पहले कारखानों, लकड़ी के गोदामों, ट्रकिंग मार्गों और किराने के वितरण केंद्रों से होकर गुजरते हैं।

segments.src: This explainer walks through how a cross-border dispute can reach everyday purchases, and which signals are worth watching as the review of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) continues.
segments.tr: यह स्पष्टकर्ता इस बात पर चर्चा करता है कि कैसे सीमा पार का विवाद रोजमर्रा की खरीद तक पहुंच सकता है, और संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका-मेक्सिको-कनाडा समझौते (USMCA) की समीक्षा जारी रहने पर कौन से संकेत देखने लायक हैं।

segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य जानकारी के लिए है।

segments.src: It is not financial, investment or legal advice, and conditions in trade policy change quickly.
segments.tr: यह वित्तीय, निवेश या कानूनी सलाह नहीं है, और व्यापार नीति में स्थितियां जल्दी बदलती हैं।

segments.src: Check official sources for the latest figures.*
segments.tr: नवीनतम आंकड़ों के लिए आधिकारिक स्रोतों की जाँच करें.*

segments.src: ## Why this trade relationship is different
segments.tr: ## यह व्यापार संबंध क्यों अलग है

segments.src: The United States and Canada trade goods and services on a scale few country pairs match.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका और कनाडा ऐसे पैमाने पर वस्तुओं और सेवाओं का व्यापार करते हैं जिसका मुकाबला कुछ ही देशों की जोड़ियाँ करती हैं।

segments.src: Much of that trade is not finished products crossing the border once.
segments.tr: उस व्यापार का अधिकांश हिस्सा सीमा पार करने वाले तैयार उत्पाद एक बार नहीं हैं।

segments.src: It is parts, materials and ingredients that move back and forth several times before reaching a customer.
segments.tr: यह ऐसे हिस्से, सामग्री और सामग्रियां हैं जो ग्राहक तक पहुंचने से पहले कई बार आगे-पीछे जाती हैं।

segments.src: That integration is the reason a tariff on one side of the line can raise costs on both.
segments.tr: वह एकीकरण ही मुख्य कारण है कि रेखा के एक तरफ का टैरिफ दोनों तरफ लागत बढ़ा सकता है।

segments.src: A duty is generally paid by the importing company.
segments.tr: आमतौर पर शुल्क का भुगतान आयात करने वाली कंपनी द्वारा किया जाता है।

segments.src: What happens next depends on the business: it can absorb the cost, negotiate with suppliers, change where it sources goods, or pass some or all of the increase on to customers.
segments.tr: आगे क्या होता है यह व्यवसाय पर निर्भर करता है: यह लागत को अवशोषित कर सकता है, आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के साथ बातचीत कर सकता है, यह बदल सकता है कि यह सामान कहां से प्राप्त करता है, या ग्राहकों पर कुछ या सभी वृद्धि का बोझ डाल सकता है।

segments.src: Economists often describe this as "pass-through," and it varies widely by product, season and market competition.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री अक्सर इसे "पास-थ्रू" के रूप में वर्णित करते हैं, और यह उत्पाद, मौसम और बाजार की प्रतिस्पर्धा के आधार पर व्यापक रूप से भिन्न होता है।

segments.src: ## Cars: a border that parts cross many times
segments.tr: ## कारें: एक सीमा जिसे हिस्से कई बार पार करते हैं

segments.src: Auto manufacturing is the clearest example of an integrated supply chain.
segments.tr: ऑटो निर्माण एक एकीकृत आपूर्ति श्रृंखला का सबसे स्पष्ट उदाहरण है।

segments.src: An engine component, a transmission or a wiring harness may cross the U.S.-Canada border more than once during assembly.
segments.tr: एक इंजन घटक, एक ट्रांसमिशन या एक वायरिंग हार्नेस असेंबली के दौरान यू.एस.-कनाडा सीमा को एक से अधिक बार पार कर सकता है।

segments.src: If duties apply at each crossing, or to certain materials such as steel and aluminum, the cost can compound.
segments.tr: यदि प्रत्येक क्रॉसिंग पर, या स्टील और एल्यूमीनियम जैसी कुछ सामग्रियों पर शुल्क लागू होते हैं, तो लागत बढ़ सकती है।

segments.src: What this can mean for shoppers:
segments.tr: खरीदारों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ हो सकता है:

segments.src: - **New vehicle prices.** Higher production costs can contribute to higher sticker prices or fewer discounts, though automakers weigh this against competition and demand.
segments.tr: - **नए वाहन की कीमतें।** उच्च उत्पादन लागत उच्च स्टिकर कीमतों या कम छूट में योगदान दे सकती है, हालांकि वाहन निर्माता प्रतिस्पर्धा और मांग के मुकाबले इसका वजन करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Repair and replacement parts.** Parts that cross the border can become more expensive, which may affect repair bills and insurance costs over time.
segments.tr: - **मरम्मत और प्रतिस्थापन भागों।** सीमा पार करने वाले हिस्से अधिक महंगे हो सकते हैं, जो समय के साथ मरम्मत के बिल और बीमा लागत को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Production decisions.** Manufacturers may shift output between plants, which can affect model availability and delivery times.
segments.tr: - **उत्पादन के निर्णय।** निर्माता संयंत्रों के बीच उत्पादन को स्थानांतरित कर सकते हैं, जो मॉडल की उपलब्धता और डिलीवरी के समय को प्रभावित कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## Lumber: housing costs and a long-running dispute
segments.tr: ## लकड़ी: आवास की लागत और लंबे समय से चला आ रहा विवाद

segments.src: Softwood lumber has been a point of friction between the two countries for decades.
segments.tr: सॉफ्टवुड लकड़ी दशकों से दोनों देशों के बीच घर्षण का बिंदु रही है।

segments.src: Canada supplies a significant share of the softwood used in American construction, and additional duties on top of existing ones can raise the cost of framing materials.
segments.tr: कनाडा अमेरिकी निर्माण में प्रयुक्त सॉफ्टवुड का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा आपूर्ति करता है, और मौजूदा लोगों के शीर्ष पर अतिरिक्त शुल्क फ्रेमिंग सामग्री की लागत को बढ़ा सकता है।

segments.src: Lumber matters beyond the lumberyard because it feeds into:
segments.tr: लकड़ी के गोदाम से परे लकड़ी मायने रखती है क्योंकि यह इसमें फीड करती है:

segments.src: - the cost of building new homes,
segments.tr: - नए घर बनाने की लागत,

segments.src: - remodeling and repair projects,
segments.tr: - रीमॉडेलिंग और मरम्मत परियोजनाएं,

segments.src: - and, indirectly, housing affordability in a market where supply is already tight.
segments.tr: - और, अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से, ऐसे बाजार में आवास की सामर्थ्य जहां आपूर्ति पहले से ही कम है।

segments.src: Builders may respond by seeking other suppliers, changing project timing or adjusting prices.
segments.tr: आपूर्तिकर्ता अन्य आपूर्तिकर्ताओं की तलाश करके, परियोजना के समय को बदलकर या कीमतों को समायोजित करके प्रतिक्रिया दे सकते हैं।

segments.src: Any effect on a particular home depends on many other factors, including interest rates, labor costs and local demand.
segments.tr: किसी विशेष घर पर कोई भी प्रभाव ब्याज दरों, श्रम लागत और स्थानीय मांग सहित कई अन्य कारकों पर निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: ## Groceries: the slow, uneven path to the checkout
segments.tr: ## किराने का सामान: चेकआउट के लिए धीमा, असमान रास्ता

segments.src: Food prices respond to trade policy less directly, but the links are real.
segments.tr: खाद्य कीमतें व्यापार नीति पर कम सीधे प्रतिक्रिया देती हैं, लेकिन कड़ियां वास्तविक हैं।

segments.src: Canada and the United States exchange large volumes of agricultural and processed goods, from produce and grains to meat, dairy and packaged foods.
segments.tr: कनाडा और संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका कृषि और प्रसंस्कृत वस्तुओं की बड़ी मात्रा का आदान-प्रदान करते हैं, उपज और अनाज से लेकर मांस, डेयरी और पैकेज्ड खाद्य पदार्थों तक।

segments.src: Packaging, fertilizer, fuel and transportation costs can also be affected by tariffs on materials and equipment.
segments.tr: पैकेजिंग, उर्वरक, ईंधन और परिवहन लागत सामग्री और उपकरणों पर टैरिफ से भी प्रभावित हो सकती है।

segments.src: Several things make grocery effects harder to predict:
segments.tr: कई चीजें किराने के प्रभावों की भविष्यवाणी करना कठिन बनाती हैं:

segments.src: - **Seasonality.** Fresh produce often comes from different regions at different times of year, so sourcing can shift.
segments.tr: - **मौसमी।** ताजी उपज अक्सर साल के अलग-अलग समय पर अलग-अलग क्षेत्रों से आती है, इसलिए सोर्सिंग बदल सकती है।

segments.src: - **Retail competition.** Grocers may absorb part of a cost increase to keep customers, or spread it across many items so no single price jumps sharply.
segments.tr: - **खुदरा प्रतिस्पर्धा।** किराना व्यापारी ग्राहकों को बनाए रखने के लिए लागत में वृद्धि के एक हिस्से को अवशोषित कर सकते हैं, या इसे कई वस्तुओं में फैला सकते हैं ताकि कोई भी कीमत तेजी से न बढ़े।

segments.src: - **Retaliation.** If one country responds to duties with its own, goods that cross the border in the other direction can be affected too.
segments.tr: - **बदला।** यदि एक देश अपने स्वयं के साथ शुष्क के प्रति प्रतिक्रिया करता है, तो दूसरी दिशा में सीमा पार करने वाले सामान भी प्रभावित हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: Consumers may notice changes first in specific categories rather than across the whole basket.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता पूरे बास्केट के बजाय विशिष्ट श्रेणियों में पहले बदलाव देख सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## What to watch in the USMCA review
segments.tr: ## USMCA समीक्षा में क्या देखना है

segments.src: The USMCA includes a scheduled joint review process, which gives all three member countries a formal moment to decide whether to extend the agreement or to keep reviewing it.
segments.tr: USMCA में एक निर्धारित संयुक्त समीक्षा प्रक्रिया शामिल है, जो सभी तीन सदस्य देशों को यह तय करने के लिए एक औपचारिक क्षण देती है कि समझौते को बढ़ाना है या इसकी समीक्षा करना जारी रखना है।

segments.src: Beyond the headlines, several developments are worth following:
segments.tr: हाथरस से परे, कई विकास का पालन करने लायक हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Whether talks resume and on what terms.** Formal negotiating sessions, rather than public statements alone, are the clearer sign of progress.
segments.tr: 1. **क्या बातचीत फिर से शुरू होती है और किन शर्तों पर।** अकेले सार्वजनिक बयानों के बजाय औपचारिक बातचीत सत्र, प्रगति का स्पष्ट संकेत हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Rules of origin.** These rules decide which products qualify for preferential treatment. Changes, especially for autos, could shift costs significantly.
segments.tr: 2. **उत्पत्ति के नियम।** ये नियम तय करते हैं कि कौन से उत्पाद तरजीही उपचार के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त करते हैं। परिवर्तन, विशेष रूप से ऑटो के लिए, लागत को काफी हद तक बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Exemptions and carve-outs.** Sector-specific relief can matter as much as a headline tariff rate.
segments.tr: 3. **छूट और नक्काशी।** सेक्टर-विशिष्ट राहत हेडलाइन टैरिफ दर जितनी महत्वपूर्ण हो सकती है।

segments.src: 4. **Dispute settlement.** How disagreements are handled can shape how predictable trade is for businesses.
segments.tr: 4. **विवाद समाधान।** असहमतियों को कैसे संभाला जाता है, यह आकार दे सकता है कि व्यवसायों के लिए व्यापार कितना अनुमानित है।

segments.src: 5. **Official price data.** Consumer price reports and producer price indexes show whether costs are moving through the economy, and how quickly.
segments.tr: 5. **आधिकारिक मूल्य डेटा।** उपभोक्ता मूल्य रिपोर्ट और उत्पादक मूल्य सूचकांक दिखाते हैं कि लागत अर्थव्यवस्था के माध्यम से आगे बढ़ रही है या नहीं, और कितनी जल्दी।

segments.src: ## What readers can do
segments.tr: ## पाठक क्या कर सकते हैं

segments.src: There is no need to react to every headline.
segments.tr: हर हेडलाइन पर प्रतिक्रिया देने की कोई आवश्यकता नहीं है।

segments.src: A few practical habits can help:
segments.tr: कुछ व्यावहारिक आदतें मदद कर सकती हैं:

segments.src: - Compare prices across retailers for big purchases such as vehicles or building materials.
segments.tr: - वाहनों या निर्माण सामग्री जैसी बड़ी खरीदारी के लिए खुदरा विक्रेताओं के बीच कीमतों की तुलना करें।

segments.src: - For home projects, ask contractors how material costs are built into quotes and how long those quotes are valid.
segments.tr: - घर की परियोजनाओं के लिए, ठेकेदारों से पूछें कि सामग्री की लागत उद्धरणों में कैसे बनाई जाती है और वे उद्धरण कितने समय तक वैध हैं।

segments.src: - Track your own grocery spending by category to see whether changes are broad or limited to certain items.
segments.tr: - श्रेणी के आधार पर अपने स्वयं के किराने के खर्च को ट्रैक करें ताकि यह देखा जा सके कि परिवर्तन व्यापक हैं या कुछ वस्तुओं तक सीमित हैं।

segments.src: - Rely on official statistics and established news outlets for trade updates rather than single social media posts.
segments.tr: - एकल सोशल मीडिया पोस्ट के बजाय व्यापार अपडेट के लिए आधिकारिक आँकड़ों और स्थापित समाचार आउटलेट पर भरोसा करें।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.tr: करीबी व्यापारिक भागीदारों के बीच टैरिफ विवाद एक ही लहर के बजाय धीमी लहर की तरह काम करते हैं।

segments.src: For cars, lumber and groceries alike, the outcome depends on how long duties last, which goods are exempted, and what negotiators agree to in the USMCA review.
segments.tr: कारों, लकड़ी और किराने के सामान के लिए समान रूप से, परिणाम इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि शुल्क कितने समय तक रहते हैं, किन सामानों को छूट दी जाती है, और USMCA समीक्षा में वार्ताकार क्या सहमत हैं।

es.title: Al norte de la frontera, precios más altos: qué significa el enfrentamiento arancelario entre EE. UU. y Canadá para los automóviles, la madera y la cesta de la compra

segments.src: When trade talks between Washington and Ottawa stall and tariffs stay in place, the effects rarely stay in the negotiating room.
segments.tr: Cuando las conversaciones comerciales entre Washington y Ottawa se estancan y los aranceles se mantienen, los efectos rara vez se quedan en la sala de negociación.

segments.src: They travel through factories, lumberyards, trucking routes and grocery distribution centers before they show up as a number on a receipt or a sticker price.
segments.tr: Viajan a través de fábricas, almacenes de madera, rutas de transporte por carretera y centros de distribución de alimentos antes de aparecer como un número en un recibo o una etiqueta de precio.

segments.src: This explainer walks through how a cross-border dispute can reach everyday purchases, and which signals are worth watching as the review of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) continues.
segments.tr: Este artículo explicativo analiza cómo una disputa transfronteriza puede llegar a las compras cotidianas y qué señales conviene vigilar a medida que avanza la revisión del Tratado entre México, Estados Unidos y Canadá (T-MEC o USMCA).

segments.tr: *Este artículo es solo para información general.

segments.src: It is not financial, investment or legal advice, and conditions in trade policy change quickly.
segments.tr: No constituye asesoramiento financiero, de inversión ni legal, y las condiciones en la política comercial cambian rápidamente.

segments.tr: Consulte fuentes oficiales para obtener las cifras más recientes.*

segments.src: ## Why this trade relationship is different
segments.tr: ## Por qué esta relación comercial es diferente

segments.src: The United States and Canada trade goods and services on a scale few country pairs match.
segments.tr: Estados Unidos y Canadá comercian bienes y servicios a una escala que pocos pares de países igualan.

segments.src: Much of that trade is not finished products crossing the border once.
segments.tr: Gran parte de ese comercio no son productos terminados que cruzan la frontera una sola vez.

segments.src: It is parts, materials and ingredients that move back and forth several times before reaching a customer.
segments.tr: Son piezas, materiales e ingredientes que van y vienen varias veces antes de llegar al cliente.

segments.src: That integration is the reason a tariff on one side of the line can raise costs on both.
segments.tr: Esa integración es la razón por la que un arancel a un lado de la línea puede elevar los costes en ambos.

segments.src: A duty is generally paid by the importing company.
segments.tr: Generalmente, el arancel lo paga la empresa importadora.

segments.src: What happens next depends on the business: it can absorb the cost, negotiate with suppliers, change where it sources goods, or pass some or all of the increase on to customers.
segments.tr: Lo que sucede a continuación depende del negocio: puede absorber el coste, negociar con los proveedores, cambiar el lugar de procedencia de los bienes o repercutir parte o la totalidad del aumento en los clientes.

segments.src: Economists often describe this as "pass-through," and it varies widely by product, season and market competition.
segments.tr: Los economistas suelen describir esto como "transmisión de precios" (pass-through), y varía ampliamente según el producto, la temporada y la competencia del mercado.

segments.src: ## Cars: a border that parts cross many times
segments.tr: ## Automóviles: una frontera que las piezas cruzan muchas veces

segments.src: Auto manufacturing is the clearest example of an integrated supply chain.
segments.tr: La fabricación de automóviles es el ejemplo más claro de una cadena de suministro integrada.

segments.src: An engine component, a transmission or a wiring harness may cross the U.S.-Canada border more than once during assembly.
segments.tr: El componente de un motor, una transmisión o un mazo de cables puede cruzar la frontera entre EE. UU. y Canadá más de una vez durante el ensamblaje.

segments.src: If duties apply at each crossing, or to certain materials such as steel and aluminum, the cost can compound.
segments.tr: Si se aplican aranceles en cada cruce, o a ciertos materiales como el acero y el aluminio, el coste puede acumularse.

segments.src: What this can mean for shoppers:
segments.tr: Lo que esto puede significar para los compradores:

segments.src: - **New vehicle prices.** Higher production costs can contribute to higher sticker prices or fewer discounts, though automakers weigh this against competition and demand.
segments.tr: - **Precios de vehículos nuevos.** Los mayores costes de producción pueden contribuir a precios de venta más altos o a menos descuentos, aunque los fabricantes de automóviles sopesan esto frente a la competencia y la demanda.

segments.src: - **Repair and replacement parts.** Parts that cross the border can become more expensive, which may affect repair bills and insurance costs over time.
segments.tr: - **Piezas de reparación y repuesto.** Las piezas que cruzan la frontera pueden encarecerse, lo que puede afectar a las facturas de reparación y a los costes del seguro con el tiempo.

segments.src: - **Production decisions.** Manufacturers may shift output between plants, which can affect model availability and delivery times.
segments.tr: - **Decisiones de producción.** Los fabricantes pueden trasladar la producción entre plantas, lo que puede afectar a la disponibilidad de modelos y a los plazos de entrega.

segments.src: ## Lumber: housing costs and a long-running dispute
segments.tr: ## Madera: costes de la vivienda y una disputa prolongada

segments.src: Softwood lumber has been a point of friction between the two countries for decades.
segments.tr: La madera de coníferas ha sido un punto de fricción entre ambos países durante décadas.

segments.src: Canada supplies a significant share of the softwood used in American construction, and additional duties on top of existing ones can raise the cost of framing materials.
segments.tr: Canadá suministra una parte significativa de la madera de coníferas utilizada en la construcción estadounidense, y los aranceles adicionales a los ya existentes pueden elevar el coste de los materiales de estructura.

segments.src: Lumber matters beyond the lumberyard because it feeds into:
segments.tr: La madera importa más allá del almacén de madera porque influye en:

segments.src: - the cost of building new homes,
segments.tr: - el coste de construcción de viviendas nuevas,

segments.src: - remodeling and repair projects,
segments.tr: - los proyectos de remodelación y reparación,

segments.src: - and, indirectly, housing affordability in a market where supply is already tight.
segments.tr: - y, de forma indirecta, la asequibilidad de la vivienda en un mercado donde la oferta ya es reducida.

segments.src: Builders may respond by seeking other suppliers, changing project timing or adjusting prices.
segments.tr: Los constructores pueden responder buscando otros proveedores, cambiando el calendario del proyecto o ajustando los precios.

segments.src: Any effect on a particular home depends on many other factors, including interest rates, labor costs and local demand.
segments.tr: Cualquier efecto en una vivienda en particular depende de muchos otros factores, incluidas las tasas de interés, los costes laborales y la demanda local.

segments.src: ## Groceries: the slow, uneven path to the checkout
segments.tr: ## Alimentos y compras: el camino lento e irregular hacia la caja

segments.src: Food prices respond to trade policy less directly, but the links are real.
segments.tr: Los precios de los alimentos responden de forma menos directa a la política comercial, pero los vínculos son reales.

segments.src: Canada and the United States exchange large volumes of agricultural and processed goods, from produce and grains to meat, dairy and packaged foods.
segments.tr: Canadá y Estados Unidos intercambian grandes volúmenes de productos agrícolas y procesados, desde frutas y granos hasta carnes, lácteos y alimentos envasados.

segments.src: Packaging, fertilizer, fuel and transportation costs can also be affected by tariffs on materials and equipment.
segments.tr: Los costes de embalaje, fertilizantes, combustible y transporte también pueden verse afectados por los aranceles sobre materiales y equipos.

segments.src: Several things make grocery effects harder to predict:
segments.tr: Varios factores hacen que los efectos en la cesta de la compra sean más difíciles de predecir:

segments.src: - **Seasonality.** Fresh produce often comes from different regions at different times of year, so sourcing can shift.
segments.tr: - **Estacionalidad.** Los productos frescos a menudo provienen de diferentes regiones en diferentes épocas del año, por lo que el abastecimiento puede cambiar.

segments.src: - **Retail competition.** Grocers may absorb part of a cost increase to keep customers, or spread it across many items so no single price jumps sharply.
segments.tr: - **Competencia minorista.** Los supermercados pueden absorber parte de un aumento de costes para mantener a los clientes, o distribuirlo entre muchos artículos para que ningún precio individual aumente drásticamente.

segments.src: - **Retaliation.** If one country responds to duties with its own, goods that cross the border in the other direction can be affected too.
segments.tr: - **Represalias.** Si un país responde a los aranceles con los suyos propios, los bienes que cruzan la frontera en la otra dirección también pueden verse afectados.

segments.src: Consumers may notice changes first in specific categories rather than across the whole basket.
segments.tr: Los consumidores pueden notar los cambios primero en categorías específicas en lugar de en toda la cesta.

segments.src: ## What to watch in the USMCA review
segments.tr: ## Qué observar en la revisión del USMCA

segments.src: The USMCA includes a scheduled joint review process, which gives all three member countries a formal moment to decide whether to extend the agreement or to keep reviewing it.
segments.tr: El USMCA incluye un proceso programado de revisión conjunta, que da a los tres países miembros un momento formal para decidir si extienden el acuerdo o continúan revisándolo.

segments.src: Beyond the headlines, several developments are worth following:
segments.tr: Más allá de los titulares, vale la pena seguir varios acontecimientos:

segments.src: 1. **Whether talks resume and on what terms.** Formal negotiating sessions, rather than public statements alone, are the clearer sign of progress.
segments.tr: 1. **Si las conversaciones se reanudan y en qué términos.** Las sesiones formales de negociación, en lugar de las solas declaraciones públicas, son la señal más clara de progreso.

segments.src: 2. **Rules of origin.** These rules decide which products qualify for preferential treatment. Changes, especially for autos, could shift costs significantly.
segments.tr: 2. **Reglas de origen.** Estas reglas deciden qué productos califican para un trato preferencial. Los cambios, especialmente para los automóviles, podrían modificar significativamente los costes.

segments.src: 3. **Exemptions and carve-outs.** Sector-specific relief can matter as much as a headline tariff rate.
segments.tr: 3. **Exenciones y excepciones.** El alivio específico por sectores puede ser tan importante como un tipo arancelario principal.

segments.src: 4. **Dispute settlement.** How disagreements are handled can shape how predictable trade is for businesses.
segments.tr: 4. **Solución de controversias.** La forma en que se manejan los desacuerdos puede determinar qué tan predecible es el comercio para las empresas.

segments.src: 5. **Official price data.** Consumer price reports and producer price indexes show whether costs are moving through the economy, and how quickly.
segments.tr: 5. **Datos oficiales de precios.** Los informes de precios al consumidor y los índices de precios al productor muestran si los costes se están moviendo a través de la economía y con qué rapidez.

segments.src: ## What readers can do
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden hacer los lectores

segments.src: There is no need to react to every headline.
segments.tr: No hay necesidad de reaccionar a cada titular.

segments.src: A few practical habits can help:
segments.tr: Unos pocos hábitos prácticos pueden ayudar:

segments.src: - Compare prices across retailers for big purchases such as vehicles or building materials.
segments.tr: - Compare precios entre minoristas para compras grandes como vehículos o materiales de construcción.

segments.src: - For home projects, ask contractors how material costs are built into quotes and how long those quotes are valid.
segments.tr: - Para proyectos en el hogar, pregunte a los contratistas cómo se incorporan los costes de los materiales en los presupuestos y cuánto tiempo son válidos dichos presupuestos.

segments.src: - Track your own grocery spending by category to see whether changes are broad or limited to certain items.
segments.tr: - Haga un seguimiento de sus propios gastos en alimentación por categoría para ver si los cambios son generales o se limitan a ciertos artículos.

segments.src: - Rely on official statistics and established news outlets for trade updates rather than single social media posts.
segments.tr: - Confíe en las estadísticas oficiales y en los medios de comunicación consolidados para obtener actualizaciones comerciales en lugar de publicaciones individuales en las redes sociales.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En resumen

segments.src: Tariff disputes between close trading partners tend to work like a slow tide rather than a single wave.
segments.tr: Las disputas arancelarias entre socios comerciales cercanos tienden a funcionar como una marea lenta en lugar de una sola ola.

segments.src: Costs can build in supply chains for months before reaching consumers, and some are absorbed along the way.
segments.tr: Los costes pueden acumularse en las cadenas de suministro durante meses antes de llegar a los consumidores, y algunos se absorben por el camino.

segments.src: For cars, lumber and groceries alike, the outcome depends on how long duties last, which goods are exempted, and what negotiators agree to in the USMCA review.
segments.tr: Tanto para los automóviles como para la madera y los alimentos, el resultado depende de cuánto duren los aranceles, qué bienes estén exentos y qué acuerden los negociadores en la revisión del USMCA.

segments.src: Following those milestones, and the official price data that follows them, is the most reliable way to understand what the standoff may mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: Seguir esos hitos, y los datos oficiales de precios que los siguen, es la forma más fiable de entender lo que el enfrentamiento puede significar para los presupuestos familiares.

segments.src: ## Why this trade relationship is different
segments.tr: ## لماذا تختلف هذه العلاقة التجارية

segments.src: The United States and Canada trade goods and services on a scale few country pairs match.
segments.tr: تتبادل الولايات المتحدة وكندا السلع والخدمات على نطاق قليل جداً من أزواج الدول التي تضاهيه.

segments.src: Much of that trade is not finished products crossing the border once.
segments.tr: الكثير من تلك التجارة ليس عبارة عن منتجات نهائية تعبر الحدود مرة واحدة.

segments.src: It is parts, materials and ingredients that move back and forth several times before reaching a customer.
segments.tr: بل هي أجزاء ومواد ومكونات تتحرك ذهاباً وإياباً عدة مرات قبل أن تصل إلى العميل.

segments.src: That integration is the reason a tariff on one side of the line can raise costs on both.
segments.tr: هذا التكامل هو السبب وراء قدرة الرسوم الجمركية على أحد جانبي الخط على رفع التكاليف على كلا الجانبين.

segments.src: A duty is generally paid by the importing company.
segments.tr: عادة ما يتم دفع الرسوم من قبل الشركة المستوردة.

segments.src: What happens next depends on the business: it can absorb the cost, negotiate with suppliers, change where it sources goods, or pass some or all of the increase on to customers.
segments.tr: ما يحدث بعد ذلك يعتمد على النشاط التجاري: يمكنه امتصاص التكلفة، أو التفاوض مع الموردين، أو تغيير مصدر الحصول على البضائع، أو تمرير بعض أو كل الزيادة إلى العملاء.

segments.src: Economists often describe this as "pass-through," and it varies widely by product, season and market competition.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يصف الاقتصاديون هذا بأنه "التمرير"، وهو يتفاوت بشكل كبير حسب المنتج والموسم والمنافسة في السوق.

segments.src: ## Cars: a border that parts cross many times
segments.tr: ## السيارات: حدود تعبرها الأجزاء مرات عديدة

segments.src: Auto manufacturing is the clearest example of an integrated supply chain.
segments.tr: تصنيع السيارات هو المثال الأوضح لسلسلة توريد متكاملة.

segments.src: An engine component, a transmission or a wiring harness may cross the U.S.-Canada border more than once during assembly.
segments.tr: قد يعبر مكون المحرك أو ناقل الحركة أو مجموعة الأسلاك حدود الولايات المتحدة وكندا أكثر من مرة أثناء التجميع.

segments.src: If duties apply at each crossing, or to certain materials such as steel and aluminum, the cost can compound.
segments.tr: إذا تم تطبيق الرسوم في كل عبور، أو على مواد معينة مثل الصلب والألومنيوم، فقد تتضاعف التكلفة.

segments.src: What this can mean for shoppers:
segments.tr: ما قد يعنيه هذا للمتسوقين:

segments.src: - **New vehicle prices.** Higher production costs can contribute to higher sticker prices or fewer discounts, though automakers weigh this against competition and demand.
segments.tr: - **أسعار المركبات الجديدة.** يمكن أن تساهم تكاليف الإنتاج الأعلى في ارتفاع الأسعار المعلنة أو تقليل الخصومات، على الرغم من أن صانعي السيارات يوازنون ذلك مقابل المنافسة والطلب.

segments.src: - **Repair and replacement parts.** Parts that cross the border can become more expensive, which may affect repair bills and insurance costs over time.
segments.tr: - **قطع الغيار والاستبدال.** يمكن أن تصبح الأجزاء التي تعبر الحدود أكثر تكلفة، مما قد يؤثر على فواتير الإصلاح وتكاليف التأمين بمرور الوقت.

segments.src: - **Production decisions.** Manufacturers may shift output between plants, which can affect model availability and delivery times.
segments.tr: - **قرارات الإنتاج.** قد يقوم المصنعون بتحويل الإنتاج بين المصانع، مما قد يؤثر على توافر الطرازات وأوقات التسليم.

segments.src: ## Lumber: housing costs and a long-running dispute
segments.tr: ## الأخشاب: تكاليف الإسكان ونزاع مستمر

segments.src: Softwood lumber has been a point of friction between the two countries for decades.
segments.tr: كان خشب الصنوبر نقطة احتكاك بين البلدين لعقود.

segments.src: Canada supplies a significant share of the softwood used in American construction, and additional duties on top of existing ones can raise the cost of framing materials.
segments.tr: توفر كندا حصة كبيرة من الخشب المستخدم في البناء الأمريكي، والرسوم الإضافية فوق الرسوم الحالية يمكن أن ترفع تكلفة مواد التأطير.

segments.src: Lumber matters beyond the lumberyard because it feeds into:
segments.tr: تكتسب الأخشاب أهمية تتجاوز مستودعات الأخشاب لأنها تؤثر في:

segments.src: - the cost of building new homes,
segments.tr: - تكلفة بناء منازل جديدة،

segments.src: - remodeling and repair projects,
segments.tr: - مشاريع إعادة البناء والإصلاح،

segments.src: - and, indirectly, housing affordability in a market where supply is already tight.
segments.tr: - وبشكل غير مباشر، القدرة على تحمل تكاليف السكن في سوق يكون فيه العرض شحيحاً بالفعل.

segments.src: Builders may respond by seeking other suppliers, changing project timing or adjusting prices.
segments.tr: قد يستجيب البناة بالبحث عن مورديين آخرين، أو تغيير توقيت المشروع، أو تعديل الأسعار.

segments.src: Any effect on a particular home depends on many other factors, including interest rates, labor costs and local demand.
segments.tr: أي تأثير على منزل معين يعتمد على العديد من العوامل الأخرى، بما في ذلك أسعار الفائدة وتكاليف العمالة والطلب المحلي.

segments.src: ## Groceries: the slow, uneven path to the checkout
segments.tr: ## البقالة: الطريق البطيء وغير المنتظم نحو الدفع

segments.src: Food prices respond to trade policy less directly, but the links are real.
segments.tr: تستجيب أسعار المواد الغذائية لسياسة التجارة بشكل أقل مباشرة، لكن الروابط حقيقية.

segments.src: Canada and the United States exchange large volumes of agricultural and processed goods, from produce and grains to meat, dairy and packaged foods.
segments.tr: تتبادل كندا والولايات المتحدة كميات كبيرة من السلع الزراعية والمصنعة، من المنتجات الطازجة والحبوب إلى اللحوم ومنتجات الألبان والأغذية المعبأة.

segments.src: Packaging, fertilizer, fuel and transportation costs can also be affected by tariffs on materials and equipment.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تتأثر تكاليف التغليف والأسمدة والوقود والنقل أيضاً بالرسوم الجمركية على المواد والمعدات.

segments.src: Several things make grocery effects harder to predict:
segments.tr: عدة أمور تجعل تأثيرات البقالة أكثر صعوبة في التنبؤ:

segments.src: - **Seasonality.** Fresh produce often comes from different regions at different times of year, so sourcing can shift.
segments.tr: - **الموسمية.** غالباً ما تأتي المنتجات الطازجة من مناطق مختلفة في أوقات مختلفة من السنة، لذا يمكن أن تتغير مصادر التوريد.

segments.src: - **Retail competition.** Grocers may absorb part of a cost increase to keep customers, or spread it across many items so no single price jumps sharply.
segments.tr: - **المنافسة بالتجزئة.** قد تمتص محلات البقالة جزءاً من زيادة التكلفة للحفاظ على العملاء، أو توزيعها عبر العديد من العناصر حتى لا يرتفع أي سعر منفرد بشكل حاد.

segments.src: - **Retaliation.** If one country responds to duties with its own, goods that cross the border in the other direction can be affected too.
segments.tr: - **الرد.** إذا استجابت دولة ما للرسوم الجمركية بفرض رسوم خاصة بها، فقد تتأثر البضائع التي تعبر الحدود في الاتجاه الآخر أيضاً.

segments.src: Consumers may notice changes first in specific categories rather than across the whole basket.
segments.tr: قد يلاحظ المستهلكون التغييرات لأول مرة في فئات محددة بدلاً من السلة بأكملها.

segments.src: ## What to watch in the USMCA review
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته في مراجعة اتفاقية USMCA

segments.src: The USMCA includes a scheduled joint review process, which gives all three member countries a formal moment to decide whether to extend the agreement or to keep reviewing it.
segments.tr: تتضمن اتفاقية USMCA عملية مراجعة مشتركة مجدولة، مما يمنح جميع الدول الأعضاء الثلاثة لحظة رسمية لقرر تمديد الاتفاقية أو مواصلة مراجعتها.

segments.src: Beyond the headlines, several developments are worth following:
segments.tr: تجاوزاً للعناوين الرئيسية، هناك عدة تطورات تستحق المتابعة:

segments.src: 1. **Whether talks resume and on what terms.** Formal negotiating sessions, rather than public statements alone, are the clearer sign of progress.
segments.tr: 1. **ما إذا كانت المحادثات ستستأنف وبأي شروط.** جلسات التفاوض الرسمية، وليس البيانات العامة وحدها، هي المؤشر الأوضح على التقدم.

segments.src: 2. **Rules of origin.** These rules decide which products qualify for preferential treatment. Changes, especially for autos, could shift costs significantly.
segments.tr: 2. **قواعد المنشأ.** تقرر هذه القواعد المنتجات التي تؤهل للمعاملة التفضيلية. التغييرات، وخاصة بالنسبة للسيارات، يمكن أن تغير التكاليف بشكل كبير.

segments.src: 3. **Exemptions and carve-outs.** Sector-specific relief can matter as much as a headline tariff rate.
segments.tr: 3. **الاستثناءات والتعليقات.** يمكن أن تكون الإعفاءات الخاصة بالقطاع بنفس أهمية معدل الرسوم الجمركية الرئيسي.

segments.src: 4. **Dispute settlement.** How disagreements are handled can shape how predictable trade is for businesses.
segments.tr: 4. **تسوية النزاعات.** كيف يتم التعامل مع الخلافات يمكن أن يشكل مدى قابلية التنبؤ بالتجارة للشركات.

segments.src: 5. **Official price data.** Consumer price reports and producer price indexes show whether costs are moving through the economy, and how quickly.
segments.tr: 5. **بيانات الأسعار الرسمية.** تقارير أسعار المستهلك ومؤشرات أسعار المنتجين توضح ما إذا كانت التكاليف تتحرك عبر الاقتصاد، وبأي سرعة.

segments.src: ## What readers can do
segments.tr: ## ما يمكن للقراء القيام به

segments.src: There is no need to react to every headline.
segments.tr: ليست هناك حاجة للتفاعل مع كل عنوان رئيسي.

segments.src: A few practical habits can help:
segments.tr: بعض العادات العملية يمكن أن تساعد:

segments.src: - Compare prices across retailers for big purchases such as vehicles or building materials.
segments.tr: - مقارنة الأسعار عبر تجار التجزئة للمشتريات الكبيرة مثل المركبات أو مواد البناء.

segments.src: - For home projects, ask contractors how material costs are built into quotes and how long those quotes are valid.
segments.tr: - بالنسبة لمشاريع المنازل، اطلب من المقاولين كيف يتم بناء تكاليف المواد في عروض الأسعار ومدة صلاحية تلك العروض.

segments.src: - Track your own grocery spending by category to see whether changes are broad or limited to certain items.
segments.tr: - تتبع إنفاقك على البقالة حسب الفئة لمعرفة ما إذا كانت التغييرات واسعة النطاق أم تقتصر على عناصر معينة.

segments.src: - Rely on official statistics and established news outlets for trade updates rather than single social media posts.
segments.tr: - الاعتماد على الإحصاءات الرسمية والمنافذ الإخبارية الراسخة للحصول على تحديثات التجارة بدلاً من منشورات وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي الفردية.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Tariff disputes between close trading partners tend to work like a slow tide rather than a single wave.
segments.tr: تميل نزاعات الرسوم الجمركية بين شركاء التجارة المقربين إلى العمل كمد بطيء بدلاً من موجة واحدة.

segments.src: Costs can build in supply chains for months before reaching consumers, and some are absorbed along the way.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تتراكم التكاليف في سلاسل التوريد لشهور قبل أن تصل إلى المستهلكين، وبعضها يتم امتصاصه على طول الطريق.

segments.src: For cars, lumber and groceries alike, the outcome depends on how long duties last, which goods are exempted, and what negotiators agree to in the USMCA review.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للسيارات والأخشاب والبقالة على حد سواء، فإن النتيجة تعتمد على المدة التي تستمر فيها الرسوم، والسلع التي يتم إعفاؤها، وما يتفق عليه المفاوضون في مراجعة USMCA.

segments.src: Following those milestones, and the official price data that follows them, is the most reliable way to understand what the standoff may mean for household budgets.
segments.tr: إن متابعة تلك المعالم، وبيانات الأسعار الرسمية التي تتبعها، هي الطريقة الأكثر موثوقية لفهم ما قد تعنيه المواجهة لميزانيات الأسر.

segments.src: ## Why this trade relationship is different
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cette relation commerciale est différente

segments.src: The United States and Canada trade goods and services on a scale few country pairs match.
segments.tr: Les États-Unis et le Canada échangent des biens et des services à une échelle que peu de paires de pays égalent.

segments.src: Much of that trade is not finished products crossing the border once.
segments.tr: Une grande partie de ce commerce ne consiste pas en des produits finis qui traversent la frontière une seule fois.

segments.src: It is parts, materials and ingredients that move back and forth several times before reaching a customer.
segments.tr: Il s'agit de pièces, de matériaux et d'ingrédients qui font de multiples aller-retours avant d'atteindre un client.

segments.src: That integration is the reason a tariff on one side of the line can raise costs on both.
segments.tr: Cette intégration explique pourquoi un droit de douane d'un côté de la frontière peut faire augmenter les coûts des deux côtés.

segments.src: A duty is generally paid by the importing company.
segments.tr: Un droit de douane est généralement payé par l'entreprise importatrice.

segments.src: What happens next depends on the business: it can absorb the cost, negotiate with suppliers, change where it sources goods, or pass some or all of the increase on to customers.
segments.tr: La suite dépend de l'entreprise : elle peut absorber le coût, négocier avec ses fournisseurs, changer de source d'approvisionnement ou répercuter une partie ou la totalité de la hausse sur ses clients.

segments.src: Economists often describe this as "pass-through," and it varies widely by product, season and market competition.
segments.tr: Les économistes qualifient souvent ce phénomène de « répercussion », et son ampleur varie considérablement selon le produit, la saison et la concurrence sur le marché.

segments.src: ## Cars: a border that parts cross many times
segments.tr: ## Voitures : une frontière que les pièces franchissent de nombreuses fois

segments.src: Auto manufacturing is the clearest example of an integrated supply chain.
segments.tr: La fabrication automobile est l'exemple le plus clair d'une chaîne d'approvisionnement intégrée.

segments.src: An engine component, a transmission or a wiring harness may cross the U.S.-Canada border more than once during assembly.
segments.tr: Un composant de moteur, une transmission ou un faisceau de câbles peut traverser la frontière entre les États-Unis et le Canada plus d'une fois lors de l'assemblage.

segments.src: If duties apply at each crossing, or to certain materials such as steel and aluminum, the cost can compound.
segments.tr: Si des droits de douane s'appliquent à chaque passage, ou à certains matériaux tels que l'acier et l'aluminium, le coût peut se cumuler.

segments.src: What this can mean for shoppers:
segments.tr: Ce que cela peut signifier pour les acheteurs :

segments.src: - **New vehicle prices.** Higher production costs can contribute to higher sticker prices or fewer discounts, though automakers weigh this against competition and demand.
segments.tr: - **Prix des véhicules neufs.** Des coûts de production plus élevés peuvent contribuer à des prix affichés plus élevés ou à moins de rabais, bien que les constructeurs automobiles comparent cela à la concurrence et à la demande.

segments.src: - **Repair and replacement parts.** Parts that cross the border can become more expensive, which may affect repair bills and insurance costs over time.
segments.tr: - **Pièces de rechange et de réparation.** Les pièces qui traversent la frontière peuvent devenir plus chères, ce qui peut influer sur les factures de réparation et les coûts d'assurance au fil du temps.

segments.src: - **Production decisions.** Manufacturers may shift output between plants, which can affect model availability and delivery times.
segments.tr: - **Décisions de production.** Les fabricants peuvent déplacer leur production d'une usine à une autre, ce qui peut influer sur la disponibilité des modèles et les délais de livraison.

segments.src: ## Lumber: housing costs and a long-running dispute
segments.tr: ## Bois d'œuvre : coûts du logement et différend de longue date

segments.src: Softwood lumber has been a point of friction between the two countries for decades.
segments.tr: Le bois d'œuvre résineux est un point de friction entre les deux pays depuis des décennies.

segments.src: Canada supplies a significant share of the softwood used in American construction, and additional duties on top of existing ones can raise the cost of framing materials.
segments.tr: Le Canada fournit une part importante du bois résineux utilisé dans la construction américaine, et des droits de douane supplémentaires venant s'ajouter à ceux déjà en place peuvent faire augmenter le coût des matériaux d'ossature.

segments.src: Lumber matters beyond the lumberyard because it feeds into:
segments.tr: Le bois d'œuvre a de l'importance au-delà du parc à bois parce qu'il entre dans :

segments.src: - the cost of building new homes,
segments.tr: - le coût de la construction de nouvelles maisons,

segments.src: - remodeling and repair projects,
segments.tr: - les projets de rénovation et de réparation,

segments.src: - and, indirectly, housing affordability in a market where supply is already tight.
segments.tr: - et, indirectement, l'accessibilité au logement sur un marché où l'offre est déjà restreinte.

segments.src: Builders may respond by seeking other suppliers, changing project timing or adjusting prices.
segments.tr: Les constructeurs peuvent réagir en cherchant d'autres fournisseurs, en modifiant le calendrier des projets ou en ajustant les prix.

segments.src: Any effect on a particular home depends on many other factors, including interest rates, labor costs and local demand.
segments.tr: Tout effet sur un logement particulier dépend de nombreux autres facteurs, notamment les taux d'intérêt, les coûts de main-d'œuvre et la demande locale.

segments.src: ## Groceries: the slow, uneven path to the checkout
segments.tr: ## Épicerie : le chemin lent et inégal vers la caisse

segments.src: Food prices respond to trade policy less directly, but the links are real.
segments.tr: Les prix des denrées alimentaires réagissent moins directement à la politique commerciale, mais les liens sont bien réels.

segments.src: Canada and the United States exchange large volumes of agricultural and processed goods, from produce and grains to meat, dairy and packaged foods.
segments.tr: Le Canada et les États-Unis échangent de grands volumes de produits agricoles et transformés, allant des fruits et légumes et des céréales à la viande, aux produits laitiers et aux aliments emballés.

segments.src: Packaging, fertilizer, fuel and transportation costs can also be affected by tariffs on materials and equipment.
segments.tr: Les coûts d'emballage, d'engrais, de carburant et de transport peuvent également être touchés par les droits de douane sur les matériaux et les équipements.

segments.src: Several things make grocery effects harder to predict:
segments.tr: Plusieurs éléments font en sorte qu'il est plus difficile de prévoir les effets sur l'épicerie :

segments.src: - **Seasonality.** Fresh produce often comes from different regions at different times of year, so sourcing can shift.
segments.tr: - **Saisonnalité.** Les fruits et légumes frais proviennent souvent de différentes régions à différentes périodes de l'année, de sorte que l'approvisionnement peut changer.

segments.src: - **Retail competition.** Grocers may absorb part of a cost increase to keep customers, or spread it across many items so no single price jumps sharply.
segments.tr: - **Concurrence au détail.** Les épiciers peuvent absorber une partie d'une hausse des coûts pour garder leurs clients, ou la répartir sur de nombreux articles afin qu'aucun prix ne connaisse une forte hausse.

segments.src: - **Retaliation.** If one country responds to duties with its own, goods that cross the border in the other direction can be affected too.
segments.tr: - **Mesures de rétorsion.** Si un pays réagit aux droits de douane par ses propres droits, les marchandises qui traversent la frontière dans l'autre sens peuvent également être touchées.

segments.src: Consumers may notice changes first in specific categories rather than across the whole basket.
segments.tr: Les consommateurs remarqueront peut-être d'abord les changements dans des catégories précises plutôt que dans l'ensemble du panier.

segments.src: ## What to watch in the USMCA review
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller dans l'examen de l'AEUMC

segments.src: The USMCA includes a scheduled joint review process, which gives all three member countries a formal moment to decide whether to extend the agreement or to keep reviewing it.
segments.tr: L'AEUMC comprend un processus d'examen conjoint prévu, ce qui donne à chacun des trois pays membres un moment officiel pour décider de prolonger l'accord ou de poursuivre son examen.

segments.src: Beyond the headlines, several developments are worth following:
segments.tr: Au-delà des grands titres, plusieurs faits nouveaux méritent d'être suivis :

segments.src: 1. **Whether talks resume and on what terms.** Formal negotiating sessions, rather than public statements alone, are the clearer sign of progress.
segments.tr: 1. **La reprise ou non des négociations et à quelles conditions.** Des séances de négociation officielles, plutôt que de simples déclarations publiques, constituent le signe le plus clair de progrès.

segments.src: 2. **Rules of origin.** These rules decide which products qualify for preferential treatment. Changes, especially for autos, could shift costs significantly.
segments.tr: 2. **Règles d'origine.** Ces règles déterminent quels produits sont admissibles à un traitement préférentiel. Des modifications, en particulier pour les automobiles, pourraient modifier considérablement les coûts.

segments.src: 3. **Exemptions and carve-outs.** Sector-specific relief can matter as much as a headline tariff rate.
segments.tr: 3. **Exemptions et exclusions.** Un allègement sectoriel peut avoir autant d'importance qu'un taux tarifaire global.

segments.src: 4. **Dispute settlement.** How disagreements are handled can shape how predictable trade is for businesses.
segments.tr: 4. **Règlement des différends.** La manière dont les désaccords sont gérés peut façonner la prévisibilité du commerce pour les entreprises.

segments.src: 5. **Official price data.** Consumer price reports and producer price indexes show whether costs are moving through the economy, and how quickly.
segments.tr: 5. **Données officielles sur les prix.** Les rapports sur les prix à la consommation et les indices des prix à la production indiquent si les coûts se propagent dans l'économie, et à quelle vitesse.

segments.src: ## What readers can do

segments.src: There is no need to react to every headline.
segments.tr: Il n'est pas nécessaire de réagir à chaque grand titre.

segments.src: A few practical habits can help:

segments.tr: - Comparer les prix d'un détaillant à l'autre pour les achats importants tels que les véhicules ou les matériaux de construction.

segments.src: - For home projects, ask contractors how material costs are built into quotes and how long those quotes are valid.
segments.tr: - Pour les projets résidentiels, demander aux entrepreneurs comment les coûts des matériaux sont intégrés dans les devis et combien de temps ces devis sont valables.

segments.src: - Track your own grocery spending by category to see whether changes are broad or limited to certain items.
segments.tr: - Suivre vos propres dépenses d'épicerie par catégorie pour voir si les changements sont vastes ou limités à certains articles.

segments.src: - Rely on official statistics and established news outlets for trade updates rather than single social media posts.
segments.tr: - S'appuyer sur des statistiques officielles et des sources d'information établies pour les mises à jour commerciales plutôt que sur de simples publications sur les réseaux sociaux.

segments.src: ## Why this trade relationship is different
segments.tr: ## Por que esta relação comercial é diferente

segments.src: The United States and Canada trade goods and services on a scale few country pairs match.
segments.tr: Os Estados Unidos e o Canadá negociam bens e serviços em uma escala que poucos pares de países igualam.

segments.src: Much of that trade is not finished products crossing the border once.
segments.tr: Grande parte desse comércio não consiste em produtos acabados cruzando a fronteira apenas uma vez.

segments.src: It is parts, materials and ingredients that move back and forth several times before reaching a customer.
segments.tr: São peças, materiais e ingredientes que vão e vêm várias vezes antes de chegar ao cliente.

segments.src: That integration is the reason a tariff on one side of the line can raise costs on both.
segments.tr: Essa integração é o motivo pelo qual uma tarifa de um lado da linha pode aumentar os custos em ambos.

segments.src: A duty is generally paid by the importing company.
segments.tr: Um imposto é geralmente pago pela empresa importadora.

segments.src: What happens next depends on the business: it can absorb the cost, negotiate with suppliers, change where it sources goods, or pass some or all of the increase on to customers.
segments.tr: O que acontece em seguida depende do negócio: ele pode absorver o custo, negociar com fornecedores, mudar o local de origem dos produtos ou repassar parte ou todo o aumento para os clientes.

segments.src: Economists often describe this as "pass-through," and it varies widely by product, season and market competition.
segments.tr: Os economistas geralmente descrevem isso como "repasse" ("pass-through"), e isso varia muito dependendo do produto, da estação e da concorrência de mercado.

segments.src: ## Cars: a border that parts cross many times
segments.tr: ## Carros: uma fronteira que as peças cruzam muitas vezes

segments.src: Auto manufacturing is the clearest example of an integrated supply chain.
segments.tr: A fabricação de automóveis é o exemplo mais claro de uma cadeia de suprimentos integrada.

segments.src: An engine component, a transmission or a wiring harness may cross the U.S.-Canada border more than once during assembly.
segments.tr: Um componente de motor, uma transmissão ou um chicote elétrico podem cruzar a fronteira entre os EUA e o Canadá mais de uma vez durante a montagem.

segments.src: If duties apply at each crossing, or to certain materials such as steel and aluminum, the cost can compound.
segments.tr: Se os impostos se aplicarem a cada travessia ou a determinados materiais, como aço e alumínio, o custo poderá se acumular.

segments.src: What this can mean for shoppers:
segments.tr: O que isso pode significar para os compradores:

segments.src: - **New vehicle prices.** Higher production costs can contribute to higher sticker prices or fewer discounts, though automakers weigh this against competition and demand.
segments.tr: - **Preços de veículos novos.** Custos de produção mais altos podem contribuir para preços de etiqueta mais altos ou menos descontos, embora as montadoras ponderem isso contra a concorrência e a demanda.

segments.src: - **Repair and replacement parts.** Parts that cross the border can become more expensive, which may affect repair bills and insurance costs over time.
segments.tr: - **Peças de reparo e reposição.** As peças que cruzam a fronteira podem se tornar mais caras, o que pode afetar as contas de reparo e os custos de seguro ao longo do tempo.

segments.src: - **Production decisions.** Manufacturers may shift output between plants, which can affect model availability and delivery times.
segments.tr: - **Decisões de produção.** Os fabricantes podem transferir a produção entre fábricas, o que pode afetar a disponibilidade de modelos e os prazos de entrega.

segments.src: ## Lumber: housing costs and a long-running dispute
segments.tr: ## Madeira: custos de moradia e uma disputa de longa data

segments.src: Softwood lumber has been a point of friction between the two countries for decades.
segments.tr: A madeira resinosas tem sido um ponto de atrito entre os dois países há décadas.

segments.src: Canada supplies a significant share of the softwood used in American construction, and additional duties on top of existing ones can raise the cost of framing materials.
segments.tr: O Canadá fornece uma parcela significativa da madeira usada na construção americana, e tarifas adicionais além das já existentes podem aumentar o custo dos materiais de estrutura.

segments.src: Lumber matters beyond the lumberyard because it feeds into:
segments.tr: A madeira importa além do pátio de madeiras porque alimenta:

segments.src: - the cost of building new homes,
segments.tr: - o custo de construção de novas residências,

segments.src: - remodeling and repair projects,
segments.tr: - projetos de reforma e reparo,

segments.src: - and, indirectly, housing affordability in a market where supply is already tight.
segments.tr: - e, indiretamente, a acessibilidade à moradia em um mercado onde a oferta já é restrita.

segments.src: Builders may respond by seeking other suppliers, changing project timing or adjusting prices.
segments.tr: Os construtores podem responder procurando outros fornecedores, alterando o cronograma do projeto ou ajustando os preços.

segments.src: Any effect on a particular home depends on many other factors, including interest rates, labor costs and local demand.
segments.tr: Qualquer efeito em uma casa específica depende de muitos outros fatores, incluindo taxas de juros, custos de mão de obra e demanda local.

segments.src: ## Groceries: the slow, uneven path to the checkout
segments.tr: ## Alimentos: o caminho lento e desigual para o caixa

segments.src: Food prices respond to trade policy less directly, but the links are real.
segments.tr: Os preços dos alimentos respondem à política comercial de forma menos direta, mas as ligações são reais.

segments.src: Canada and the United States exchange large volumes of agricultural and processed goods, from produce and grains to meat, dairy and packaged foods.
segments.tr: O Canadá e os Estados Unidos trocam grandes volumes de produtos agrícolas e processados, desde produtos frescos e grãos até carne, laticínios e alimentos embalados.

segments.src: Packaging, fertilizer, fuel and transportation costs can also be affected by tariffs on materials and equipment.
segments.tr: Os custos de embalagem, fertilizantes, combustível e transporte também podem ser afetados por tarifas sobre materiais e equipamentos.

segments.src: Several things make grocery effects harder to predict:
segments.tr: Várias coisas tornam os efeitos nos supermercados mais difíceis de prever:

segments.src: - **Seasonality.** Fresh produce often comes from different regions at different times of year, so sourcing can shift.
segments.tr: - **Sazonalidade.** Os produtos frescos geralmente vêm de regiões diferentes em épocas diferentes do ano, portanto, o fornecimento pode mudar.

segments.src: - **Retail competition.** Grocers may absorb part of a cost increase to keep customers, or spread it across many items so no single price jumps sharply.
segments.tr: - **Concorrência no varejo.** Os supermercados podem absorver parte do aumento de custo para manter os clientes, ou distribuí-lo por muitos itens para que nenhum preço único suba drasticamente.

segments.src: - **Retaliation.** If one country responds to duties with its own, goods that cross the border in the other direction can be affected too.
segments.tr: - **Retaliação.** Se um país responder a tarifas com as suas próprias, os produtos que cruzam a fronteira na direção oposta também poderão ser afetados.

segments.tr: Os consumidores podem notar mudanças primeiro em categorias específicas, em vez de em toda a cesta.
